changes.description: Removed dead _agent_debug_log function and all 6 call sites. Added _EVOX_WARNED flag and _warn_evox_unavailable() called at start of _run_nsga2_fallback and _nsga3_environmental_selection. Updated plateau restart log to include mutation rate. Added restarts={n}/{max} to generation log lines. Added viability-collapse trigger (PHASE2_VIABILITY_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD/STREAK) in both main loops. Replaced biased reference-vector fallback with proper Das-Dennis uniform simplex.
Added PHASE2_VIABILITY_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD=0.5 and PHASE2_VIABILITY_COLLAPSE_STREAK=3 config flags.
Added restarts parameter to log_generation() and maybe_log_generation() for restarts={n}/{max} in gen log.
Updated _sample_df docstring to clarify random_state is intentionally ignored.
